units.rawText: You want me to enjoy more of the Oasis' recreational activities? By myself? (Sigh) Professor, have you forgotten that my job is to establish a relationship with the Oasis and monitor you?

units.rawText: Do you think I'm the kind of Sanctifier who would abandon her tasks and run off to have fun? Or are you saying you wish to escape my oversight?
